day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The drawer handle's wobbling. Two turns with a screwdriver, done today.

reasons: Horse pairs with Goat — a harmonious day
signs.motif: an old routine that no longer fits
signs.message: You outgrew that morning lineup months ago. Rebuild it today.

reasons: Pig and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a heat that slows the day
signs.message: Heat's flattening everyone else. Get your thing done before ten.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a note to self from March
signs.message: March you left instructions. She was right, start it today.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the bank holiday nobody planned for
signs.message: Turns out today's a holiday. Fix the small stuff at home.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Somebody still owes for last week's table. Say the number plainly.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the good day you did not notice
signs.message: Yesterday was quietly good. Write down why before you forget it.

reasons: Rabbit and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the printer queue with your name on it
signs.message: Your pages are still sitting in that tray. Go get them.

reasons: Goat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the plan made on a whim
signs.message: That impulse plan can un-happen. Say so early, then stay in.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You skipped the forecast and it was right. Indoors wins tonight.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Staring at the countdown won't move it. Screen down, blanket on.

reasons: Ox opposes Goat — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a bag of clothes for donation
signs.message: That bag isn't going anywhere today. Neither are you, happily.
